title: End-of-Line Robotics Engineer
description: You want to help build Europe’s resilience? You want to protect people and critical infrastructure? You want to work at the frontier of high-performance autonomous systems? Join CDDS and take ownership of our robotic End-of-Line test station, ensuring reliable and thorough validation of every drone. CDDS specializes in developing low-collateral kinetic interceptors designed to neutralize malicious drones, including Mavics, FPV racers, and fast fixed wings. Our solutions are built for precision and safety, minimizing risk to surroundings while countering threatening unmanned aerial systems. We work at the cutting edge of counter-drone technology, delivering reliable protection for critical assets and environments. Tasks Your mission We are looking for an exceptional End-of-Line Robotics Engineer to take ownership of the automated stations that check every produced drone before it flies. These checks span very different fields: propulsion, sensors, calibration, radio links, power and structure. You will be at the heart of our quality control: understand how a drone can fail, find the best way to detect it, and turn that into a reliable validation test on the production line. You will work closely with our R&D and production teams, with the autonomy to shape the test architecture and the responsibility to prove it on the line. We are looking for rigour, curiosity and the persistence to follow a defect from its first symptom to a test that catches it every time. Core responsibilities Explore different ways to detect each drone defect, choose what to measure and set pass/fail criteria based on data. Design and maintain the test software framework: sequencing tests, driving instruments and robots, logging results and linking every measurement to a drone's serial number. Program handling routines for our collaborative robot and integrate them safely with fixtures and sensors. Move proven tests into the Calibration & Validation room, make them robust for daily use by operators, and improve cycle time, coverage and uptime as volumes grow. Analyse results across the fleet, spot trends and drifts, and report defects to design and production so they are fixed at the source. Requirements Your profile You combine strong engineering and analytical skills with solid software craft. You break complex problems down, reason from data rather than assumptions, and enjoy getting a station working hands-on, not only in code. At least 2 years in test engineering, validation, test automation or production test, ideally on robotic or electromechanical products. Solid robotics fundamentals: modelling system dynamics, choosing sensors and actuators: understanding their trade-offs (noise, bias, bandwidth, cost). Comfortable with reference frames and transforms: relating to IMU, camera and robot or vehicle frames, and how their data is fused together. General knowledge of state estimation and control theory (e.g. Kalman filtering, PID and feedback loops), enough to understand how a drone or robot behaves and why a test result looks the way it does. Strong Python (or similar) for test automation, hardware control and data analysis; comfortable on Linux. And tools such as Docker, Github etc... Experience interfacing software with hardware over common protocols: serial/Ethernet devices, DAQ, sensors. MSc or PhD in robotics, mechatronics, computer science, electronics or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated experience. Nice-to-have Classic computer vision and image processing (e.g. OpenCV): camera calibration, feature detection, measuring and inspecting parts from images. Signal processing on test data: filtering, FFT and vibration analysis, anomaly detection on time series. Programming collaborative robots, such as the Fairino FR5 or an equivalent (UR, Doosan, ABB GoFa…), and ROS/ROS 2. Drone or UAV testing: autopilots (PX4/ArduPilot), telemetry and flight log analysis. Deep knowledge of one or more embedded sensor (IMU, magnetometer, barometer, GNSS, cameras), their typical failure modes and calibration methods (e.g. camera–IMU). Test data infrastructure: databases (SQL, time-series), dashboards (e.g. Grafana), traceability systems. Experience in a regulated industry. Reading or writing C/C++ for firmware and embedded tools. Benefits Why CDDS Direct impact on a mission-critical technology shaping Europe’s security landscape. Fast-moving startup environment with high ownership. Work with a highly technical, ambitious, and hands-on team. Real-world testing, deployments, and customer demonstrations. Attractive compensation. Details Location: Zürich Hardbrücke, on-site Start date: ASAP Environment: High-impact deep-tech startup working on real deployments If you are interested in the position, please apply via the application form.
